findings.message: D6 は `.harness/prompts/` 配下のテンプレートを読むと決めていますが、正 canonical path/filename や選択規則を定義していません。複数テンプレートが存在し得るため、spec/実装はどの discipline を注入すべきか、欠如時の fail-closed 条件を導出できません。

D6 の no-git discipline は subprocess dispatch にしか自動注入されず、D7 の Claude==Claude の in-host 分岐は briefing を使った self-invoke 指示だけを返します。したがって、経路に常時注入するという安全方針が分岐によって失われ、in-host 実行では外部 discipline template が適用されません。in-host 分岐への伝播契約を明示してください。
findings.category: inconsistent decisions within the same ADR

findings.message: D4 names codex, claude, and gemini as providers handled by the common dispatch path, but D10 defines adapter/conformance behavior only for claude and codex and requires fail-closed behavior when no adapter registry exists. The ADR does not specify whether Gemini is currently supported or how its adapter, permissions, and invocation contract work.
findings.category: inconsistent decisions within the same ADR

findings.message: The Claude fallback in D10 is incompatible with D3/D5: `--append-system-prompt-file` can inject agent text but does not bind the agent frontmatter's `tools:` permissions or model. If `--agent` fails in headless mode, the specified fallback can therefore run with the wrong model and without the declared tool restrictions. The ADR must either require fail-closed behavior or specify equivalent enforcement for the fallback.
findings.category: inconsistent decisions within the same ADR

findings.message: D3/D5 は `agent-profiles.json` の capability model を SSoT とする一方、D7/D10 は Claude の agent 定義 frontmatter が per-capability model を束縛すると記述しています。profile model と adapter model が異なる場合の優先順位・一致条件が定義されておらず、in-host と subprocess の実行モデルを spec から一意に導出できません。
findings.category: inconsistent decisions within the same ADR

findings.message: D2 は `agent-profiles.json` に存在する全 capability を dispatch 可能な宇宙と定義していますが、D9 は同じ profile に存在する reviewer / dry-checker / ref-verifier / obligation・waiver verifier を本コマンドの対象外としています。対象外 capability を拒否する規則はなく、capability のハードコードも D2 で禁止されているため、下流 spec は `sotp capability exec reviewer` を自由形式で実行するのか fail-closed にするのか決定できません。
findings.category: inconsistent decisions within the same ADR

findings.message: Rejected Alternative D は CLI sandbox フラグの代わりに「profile field 宣言」を採択したと記述していますが、最終的な D3 は profile に権限 field を設けず adapter 定義ファイルへ置くと決定しています。却下理由が旧設計のままで、Decision と Rejected Alternatives の narrative が矛盾しています。

findings.message: D6 defines fail-closed validation for the discipline template but never defines validation semantics for the user-supplied briefing file itself. In particular, the in-host branch can return a successful delegation instruction containing a missing, unreadable, invalid-UTF-8, or empty briefing path, while the subprocess branch may launch before discovering the same defect. This leaves spec.json unable to derive observable error behavior for invalid briefing input. Specify which briefing conditions are rejected and require validation before either dispatch branch.

T001 claims it will “expose the profile/source/provider ports,” but task-contract.json attributes CapabilityProfilePort, CapabilityProviderPort, and CapabilitySourcePort only to T002. Align the description and attribution so the executable task boundary is unambiguous.
T001 restates upstream behavior in “validated request” and “port-boundary validation failures”; retain only target + operation + anchor cite.

T002 restates the behavior contract in “validate briefing and discipline,” “resolve profiles without capability-specific branching,” “reject invalid execution mode,” and “fail-closed”; retain only target + operation + anchor cite.
T003 restates upstream design rationale in “Keep routing/model authority in profiles and provider-specific permissions in adapters”; retain only target + operation + anchor cite.
T004 restates input-validation behavior in “regular readable UTF-8 nonblank inputs” and “without fallback”; retain only target + operation + anchor cite.

T005 restates provider execution behavior in “preflight provider-native definitions,” “verified native invocation contracts,” “read-only default,” and “no raw-definition fallback”; retain only target + operation + anchor cite.
T006 restates outcome and error behavior in “discriminated execution and in-host outcomes,” “non-success error rendering,” and “outcome discrimination”; retain only target + operation + anchor cite.
T007 restates CLI behavior in “argument absence,” “dispatch forwarding,” and “rejection of the retired command”; retain only target + operation + anchor cite.
T008 restates end-to-end behavior in “valid dispatch,” “in-host delegation,” “rejection-before-spawn,” and “preservation of typed pipelines”; retain only target + operation + anchor cite.
T009 restates operational behavior in “writer route remains available while the retired planner path is absent”; retain only target + operation + anchor cite.
Section S1 restates upstream type-design rationale in “validated-value, enum-first, and port-boundary decisions”; retain only sequencing and task references.

Section S2 restates upstream behavior and rationale in “fixed discipline path,” “fail-closed preflight tests,” and “D10 provider-native execution contract”; retain only sequencing and task references.
Section S4 restates the safety/behavior contract in “proves the replacement route,” “removal ... safe,” and “no live writer guidance remains orphaned”; retain only sequencing and task references.

GO-02 は briefing 規律を全 dispatch 経路で保証するとしているが、subprocess prompt に検証済み briefing と discipline 本文が含まれることを証明する AC がない。AC-03 は事前検証、AC-05 は in-host payload、AC-06 は native adapter の起動形式しか確認しないため、subprocess が両本文を欠落させても全 AC を満たせる。
findings.category: missing AC coverage for a stated goal

findings.message: `CapabilityExecError::InvalidRequest` is unconstructible: `CapabilityExecService::execute` accepts an already-typed `CapabilityExecRequest`; declared constructors return `CapabilityInputValidationError` directly, and `CapabilityDriver::handle` returns `CommandOutcome`. No declared caller can wrap that error into this variant.

`CapabilityProfilePort::resolve` returns the broad `CapabilityExecError`, but the declared profile adapter can only produce `ProfileResolution` or `ModelMissing`. The entry does not document this producible subset; `InvalidRequest`, `ExecutionModeRejected`, `UnsupportedProvider`, `SourceValidation`, `AdapterPreflight`, and `DispatchFailed` are structurally unreachable here.

`CapabilityProviderPort::dispatch` returns the broad `CapabilityExecError`, although the interactor selects a matching provider and the provider adapters can only produce `AdapterPreflight` or `DispatchFailed`. The entry does not document the narrower subset, forcing callers to handle unreachable profile/source/input variants.

`CapabilitySourcePort::load_briefing` and `load_discipline` return the broad `CapabilityExecError`, although both declared operations can only produce `SourceValidation`. The entry does not document this subset, so callers must handle unrelated profile, provider, and dispatch failures.

`CapabilityProfilePort::resolve`, `CapabilitySourcePort::load_briefing`, `CapabilitySourcePort::load_discipline`, and `CapabilityProviderPort::dispatch` are all declared synchronous despite performing profile-file, filesystem, and subprocess/provider I/O. Their docs do not acknowledge the synchronous boundary choice, leaving the port color contract underspecified for adapters.

`ReasoningEffortDto` is anchored only to `CN-02`, whose scope covers profile capability/routing/model/execution-mode authority and adapter authority; it contains no reasoning-effort contract. The entry therefore declares an unrelated API addition, and its docs restate a behavior not committed by this spec.

`CapabilityConfigDto` claims existing reasoning-effort accessors are preserved, but its declared `fast_reasoning_effort` and `final_reasoning_effort` signatures change from the baseline raw-string accessors to `Option<ReasoningEffortDto>`. This is an undeclared compatibility change for existing consumers and contradicts the entry's own docs.

The `docs` fields for `BriefingText`, `CapabilityDispatchOutcome`, `CapabilityDispatchRequest`, `CapabilityExecError`, `CapabilityExecInteractor`, `CapabilityExecRequest`, `CapabilityFailureDetail`, `CapabilityFilePath`, `CapabilityInputValidationError`, `CapabilityName`, `CapabilityProfile`, `DisciplineText`, `ExecutionMode`, `ModelName`, `ProviderName`, `CapabilityExecService`, `CapabilityProfilePort`, `CapabilityProviderPort`, and `CapabilitySourcePort` restate upstream validation, routing, branching, and error contracts in prose instead of only citing their anchors.

The `docs` fields for `AgentProfilesCapabilityAdapter`, `CapabilityConfigDto`, `ClaudeCapabilityAdapter`, `CodexCapabilityAdapter`, `ExecutionModeDto`, `FsCapabilitySourceAdapter`, `ModelNameDto`, `ProviderNameDto`, `ReasoningEffortDto`, and `SandboxMode` restate upstream parsing, adapter, sandbox, and conversion behavior in prose instead of only citing their anchors.

The `docs` fields for `CapabilityDriver`, `CapabilityExecDriverInput`, `CapabilityNameArg`, and `ProviderNameArg` restate upstream input-validation, conversion, and rendering behavior in prose instead of only citing their anchors.
The `docs` fields for `CapabilityCommand` and `CapabilityExecArgs` restate the generic dispatch and input-validation contract in prose instead of only citing their anchors.
The `CapabilityCompositionRoot` docs restate the adapter wiring and dispatch responsibility contract in prose instead of only citing its anchors.

`CapabilityConfigDto` の `provider` / `model` / `fast_provider` / `fast_model` / `prompt_template_path` は baseline の `&str` / `Option<&str>` から DTO・`Path` 型へ変更されていますが、entry docs は既存 accessor のシグネチャ維持を宣言しています。破壊的変更を明示するか、baseline 互換の戻り値に戻してください。
`ExecutionMode` の docs が、`TypedPipeline` を起動前に拒否し `OrchestratorOutput` のみ dispatch するという upstream の挙動契約を散文で再掲しています。types docs は upstream anchor の参照に留めてください。
